name: wallpaper-picker
title: Wallpaper Picker
description: Browse the wallpaper library and apply it with a matugen theme.
author: silent

commands.name: set-wallpaper
commands.title: Set Wallpaper
commands.subtitle: Wallpaper Picker
commands.description: Browse wallpapers, then choose a palette to theme the desktop with.

preferences.name: wallpaperDirectory
preferences.title: Wallpaper folder
preferences.description: Optional folder to scan instead of ~/Pictures/wallpaper. Subfolders are included up to the scan depth below.

preferences.name: scanDepth
preferences.title: Subfolder depth
preferences.description: How many levels below the wallpaper folder are scanned.

preferences.name: includeCurrent
preferences.title: Library coverage
preferences.description: Keep the currently applied wallpaper visible even when it lives outside the scanned folder.
preferences.label: Include the current wallpaper

preferences.name: columns
preferences.title: Columns
preferences.description: How many wallpapers per row. Fewer columns means larger previews.

preferences.name: layoutMode
preferences.title: Grid layout
preferences.description: Sections organize the library; Flat removes headers and is the lightest layout.

preferences.name: searchMode
preferences.title: Grid mode
preferences.description: Search filters wallpapers; Browse keeps the full grid visible for keyboard navigation. Either way, Ctrl+Shift+B swaps modes without leaving the picker.

preferences.name: defaultSort
preferences.title: Default sort
preferences.description: How wallpapers are ordered when the picker opens.

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Enter action
preferences.description: What pressing Enter on a wallpaper does first.

data.title: Set wallpaper and keep the current theme

preferences.name: transition
preferences.title: Wallpaper transition
preferences.description: Animation used when applying a wallpaper.

preferences.name: transitionDuration
preferences.title: Transition duration
preferences.description: How long animated transitions take. Auto uses the preset's tuned duration.

preferences.name: resizeMode
preferences.title: Wallpaper fit
preferences.description: How images are fitted to each display.

preferences.name: cropGravity
preferences.title: Crop anchor
preferences.description: Which part stays visible when crop mode trims an image. Only used when the wallpaper fit above is Crop.

scripts.bundle: rm -rf assets/backend && mkdir -p assets/backend && cp ../*.sh assets/backend/
scripts.build: npm run bundle && vici build && sh scripts/themed-icon.sh
